description.zh: 退休后的贝爷在底层开起了拾荒铺：旧日背包、手电、扫描仪与战斗匕首仍在，店里备有标签机、放大镜与冶金手册；随身止血绷带、能量饮料与巧克力棒；开局现金减少 400。
description.en: The Retired Bear runs a scavenger shop: old backpack, flashlight, scanner, and combat knife; plus labeler, magnifier, and metallurgy manual; hemostatic bandage, energy drink, and chocolate bar on hand; begin with 400 less cash.
